title: Spiral Staircase Escape
description: A woman in an orange jumpsuit ascends a dilapidated spiral staircase inside a ruined building. The ceiling has collapsed, revealing a swirling colorful vortex in the sky above while film reels, broken frames, and glowing plants litter the decaying steps.
prompt: A woman wearing an orange prison jumpsuit climbs a decaying spiral metal staircase inside a crumbling concrete building covered in vines and glowing moss. She holds the railing and looks upward toward a massive swirling colorful vortex visible through the collapsed ceiling. Old film reels, movie posters and broken picture frames are scattered on the stairs. Cinematic lighting with dramatic god rays, surreal atmosphere, detailed textures, in the style of a cinematic digital painting.
